_comment: Evidence-backed mainnet gates. `satisfied` may ONLY be set true when the
named evidence file exists AND its sha256 equals `evidence_sha256`.
scripts/mainnet-gate.sh recomputes every digest, so flipping a flag
without producing real evidence fails the gate.
Set `evidence` to null and `satisfied` to false for anything not yet done.

superseded._note: Immutable and untouched. Superseded, not replaced.

live_note_level_reorg.note: CI runs 34682825442 and 34685408616, real zebrad v6.3.0 nodes. CASE A/B/C incl. A->B->A. The retained-note-row observation is CLOSED: root cause is upstream un-mine-don't-delete truncation; no money path affected.

activation_boundary_reorg.note: CI run 34682825442. Fork below the activation height; persisted == restart == clean-reindex root.

fresh_frozen_rc_testnet_activation.note: The existing public-testnet history predates the protocol freeze; see TESTNET-ACTIVATION-AUDIT.md. Requires owner approval to execute.

external_security_audit_complete.note: No external audit has been commissioned.

zero_unresolved_critical.note: Must equal 0 once an audit exists. Never set true on the grounds that no findings exist.

zero_unresolved_high.note: Must equal 0 once an audit exists. Never set true on the grounds that no findings exist.

fixes_produced_new_immutable_rc.note: Vacuous until audit fixes exist; must name the new RC tag and commit.

two_node_public_testnet_root_equality.note: Must be re-established against the FRESH frozen-RC activation, not the pre-freeze history.

activation_runbook_reviewed.note: No MAINNET activation runbook exists yet. audit/TESTNET-ACTIVATION-RUNBOOK.md covers the testnet activation only; the mainnet one must be written and signed off by the owner before this gate can close.

mainnet_canary_owner_approved.note: Explicit owner approval required. Never inferred.

auditor_final_candidate_signoff.note: Required whenever the final candidate's manifest hash differs from the audited candidate's - which it always will once a mainnet activation height is set. Either direct sign-off on the exact final candidate, or written delta confirmation naming that exact commit and manifest hash.

audited_candidate._comment: The candidate an external auditor actually reviewed. Filled in ONLY when a real audit report exists.
